item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.63)] Apple faces class action over alleged ‘bricking’ of older Apple Watch models
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.63)
Apple is facing a new class action lawsuit alleging that the company prematurely ended software support for several older Apple Watch models, effectively "bricking" them and forcing consumers to buy new devices. The lawsuit claims Apple's watchOS 27 update is incompatible with models like the SE 2, Series 6, 7, 8, and Ultra 1, which were sold recently and had not yet reached their useful life. The plaintiff, Richard Goetz, alleges unfair business practices and seeks to represent California consumers who purchased these affected Apple Watch models.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.43)] NVK Vulkan Video Merged For Mesa 26.3
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.43)
The NVK Vulkan driver in Mesa has received initial support for Vulkan Video, specifically H.264 decoding, which has been merged into Mesa 26.3-devel. This new feature required significant reverse engineering and Rust programming implementation, and currently only supports Turing and newer NVIDIA GPUs due to reliance on the NVIDIA GSP. The full NVK Vulkan Video support, including H.264, is expected to debut in Mesa 26.3, set for a stable release in Q4, coinciding with the Linux 7.3 kernel which provides the necessary Nouveau patch.
